headline: AI could cut the banking industry's cost base by 20% or more
body: AI could cut the banking industry's cost base by 20% or more, according to a McKinsey report. The report says most firms have so far only used the technology to boost individual employees' productivity, with negligible impact on the bottom line.
note: The gap sits between that estimate and the bottom line firms have seen so far.

figure.label: possible cut to the banking industry's cost base, per the report
